ground_truth.description: The removal also deleted the blank line that separated the field definitions from the `@model_validator` method, so the closing `)` of `judge_cli_timeout_seconds` is now directly adjacent to `@model_validator(mode='after')`. PEP8 (E301) expects one blank line before a method definition inside a class.

The class docstring still reads 'Tests for the three dedicated CLI-timeout / claim-recovery fields on ReconciliationConfig', but the claim-recovery field was removed, leaving only the two CLI-timeout fields; the docstring is now inaccurate.

provenance.runs_db_query: SELECT task_id, project_id, outcome, review_cycles, verify_attempts FROM task_results WHERE review_cycles >= 1, cross-referenced with events (escalation_created, merge_finalized) -- see mining.mine_fn_candidates.
